description: Source code for startParodus.cpp, a program that initializes and runs the Parodus client with configuration parameters fetched from files, environment variables, and RFC parameters. It includes functions to retrieve device-specific information such as MAC address, partner ID, reboot reason, firmware name, and serial number, and then constructs and executes the Parodus process with these parameters.

methods.name: get_HWMAcAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address from a file and formats it as a string.

methods.name: get_PartnerId
methods.description: Reads the partner ID from a file or fetches it via RFC parameter, processes and returns it.

methods.name: get_RebootReason
methods.description: Reads and parses the reboot reason from a JSON-formatted file.

methods.name: get_FwName
methods.description: Reads the firmware name from the version file.
